title: Report a missing 'engram work core held' in readiness before the first mediated admission
outcome: From tm-winf round-8 review (Claude, Note). Since tm-winf step 3 every Engram bind reads 'engram work core held'; against an older Engram build every mediated session's bind fails (control cards instead of a binding), with the error 'install a newer Engram' (ENGRAM_WORK_CORE_HELD_MISSING_DIAGNOSTIC). The requirement is documented in docs/features/engram-host-adapter.md. Consider having the project readiness / doctor probe run the subcommand and report the missing capability before the first admission, so the break is seen at enable time rather than on the first turn.
